**Proton VPN CLI for Docker**
Run the official Proton VPN CLI with a WebUI for sign-in, TOTP, settings, connection status and traffic. Other containers can share its VPN network namespace, with a fail-closed firewall and NAT-PMP forwarded-port reporting.
Requires a Linux Docker host with cgroup v2, xt_cgroup, WireGuard kernel support and /dev/net/tun. Proton does not officially support headless use. The firewall protects against accidental leaks, not hostile code in attached containers.
**Repository:** [github.com/andrebrait/protonvpn-cli-docker](https://github.com/andrebrait/protonvpn-cli-docker) **Support:** [github.com/andrebrait/protonvpn-cli-docker/issues](https://github.com/andrebrait/protonvpn-cli-docker/issues)
This project is not affiliated with Proton AG. The Proton VPN icon is Proton AG's trademark, used to identify the service.
